name: web-dark-core-features-bento-with-selectable-feature-tiles-and-code-snippet
title: Black bento 'Core Features' with four selectable tiles and a selected readout, live performance metrics, integrations, a deploy code block and a stats row
whatItIs: A black dashboard with a file tab, a large card with a small badge, 'Core Features' and a 2x2 of tiles (Lightning Fast, Smart Caching, Global Scale, Enterprise Security) where one is highlighted and its detail '0.3ms' appears in a Selected box; a Performance card with Live tag and metric rows; an Integrations card with framework icon tiles; a Deploy Command card with a scrolling code block; and a bottom row of four stat cards.
whatItMeans: Technical and interactive; selectable tiles and real code show a product working.
techniques: Let tiles act as selectors for a detail readout.
Show real code in a card.
Use small stat cards with icons.
Keep all cards dark with hairline borders.

vocabulary.definition: A tile that updates a detail area when chosen.
A card containing a syntax-style code block.
A small card with an icon, label and value.
